title: Great Expectations Failures by Suite
app: Great Expectations checkpoint results forwarded as JSON to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=greatexpectations:validation success="false"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by expectation_suite
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Great Expectations failures grouped by suite so operators immediately see which specific suites are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Great Expectations is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Great Expectations failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical suites.
visualization: Table of suite by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Great Expectations are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
